layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy, padding p-8 to p-16 to give luxurious feel.
layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: Mobile-first, single column to responsive multi-column. Product images and checkout forms prominently displayed.

components.cta_buttons: Large, high contrast (Primary Green), hover slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-lg. Rounded moderately (rounded-md).
components.cards: Subtle border (border-gray-200), max 8px radius, no heavy shadows. Flat solid surface.
components.trust_badges: Minimalist icons in a row with muted text underneath. Free shipping, COD, 14-days return.
components.product_gallery: Left side product image, sticky right side product details, sticky CTA on mobile.
components.countdown_timer: Subtle but clear text or inline component. Not annoying. E.g., 'Oferta expira in: 02:15:30'.

interactions_and_motion.hover: Subtle translate and shadow for interactive elements.
interactions_and_motion.entrance: Framer motion fade in and slide up (y: 20 -> 0) for lists and sections.

sections: Hero: Headline with value prop + CTA to scroll to products. Uses hero_background image with subtle light overlay.
Trust Bar: 3 columns (Livrare Rapida, Plata la Livrare, Retur usor).
Product Grid: List of demo products with image, title, price, and 'Cumpara Acum' button linking to product landing page.
Footer: Minimalist footer with copyright and links.

Product View: Left - Large high quality image. Right - Title, Price (highlighted), Stars/Reviews snippet, Urgency (Countdown, Limited Stock - e.g. 'Doar X ramase in stoc'). Big CTA 'Comanda acum - Plata la livrare' (anchor to checkout), Benefits list.
Social Proof: Customer reviews with stars and comments.
Order Form: Paperform embed placeholder section. Use an iframe or div simulating the COD form with a prop or placeholder for the real Paperform link.
Trust Badges: Placed near the order form.

testing.required_attributes: Add data-testid on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, etc.)

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement product landing pages as dynamic route (e.g., /product/:id).
Ensure 'Comanda acum' CTA gracefully scrolls to the Paperform embed section or opens it in a dialog.
Use Framer Motion for entrance animations (e.g., product cards staggering in, hero text sliding up).
Implement a realistic countdown timer (e.g., ending at midnight or a fixed duration).
Admin dashboard requires basic auth context and CRUD logic for products.
